g.text: 1. The Tic-Tac-Toe game should be played on a 3x3 grid. (Dymanic Size)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2. Two players take turns marking their symbols (X or O) on the grid.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3. The first player to get three of their symbols in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) wins the game. (Dynamic Winning Strategies)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4. If all the cells on the grid are filled and no player has won, the game ends in a draw.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5. The game should have a user interface to display the grid and allow players to make their moves.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6. The game should handle player turns and validate moves to ensure they are legal.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 7. The game should detect and announce the winner or a draw at the end of the game.
